state:
**Goal `ext-intl`: Stage 8, the feature proofs, is in progress.** Stages 1 to 7 are on disk: every export of `nvs:intl/icu` works, both components are embedded, and the growth test and the bundle test pass.

`Novis\Intl\Collator`, `NumberFormat`, `PluralRules`, `RelativeTime`, `ListFormat` and `Segmenter` owe nothing: `bun nv proofs --verify --group '<Class>'` passes for each. Their Rust tests in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs` carry `covers:` markers, and the existing `.nvst` cases credit the Novis side by a plain call.

Still red: `Novis\Intl\DateFormat`, `Novis\Intl\Locale`, and `Novis\Intl\Icu`, the manifest class. The first two each have 1 of 2 cases (the Rust `covers:` marker is missing) and no about page, examples, attack or bench. The gate output names each owed path. `bun nv proofs --id` does not find a `Novis\` feature in any quoting, so use the group gate.

`--record-perf` refuses with "the calibration did not measure anything" when the machine is busy; running it again a minute later worked. A word-segmenting attack over a large Japanese text grows about linearly but took over 20s under parallel load, so keep attack inputs near tens of thousands of characters.

Copy the shape of `Intl-ListFormat`. After the benches, run `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group '<Class>'`, then `bun nv proofs --comments` over the three trees.
